content: Surgical procedures for obesity treatment, often referred to as bariatric, metabolic, or metabolic/bariatric surgeries, are terms that are frequently used interchangeably when discussing weight loss interventions. These surgical interventions have been scientifically demonstrated to produce significant improvements in type 2 diabetes management, enhance glycemic control, and facilitate substantial weight loss, even in individuals who were not previously diagnosed with obesity. Research has also consistently shown that these procedures lead to a reduction in cardiovascular risks and result in notable improvements in overall metabolic profiles.
